content:
Apple TV's fall slate boasts a strong lineup, with major new series premiering every week for four consecutive weeks, kicking off next week with the critically acclaimed "Slow Horses" ("無間叛徒"). Below are the upcoming titles.

September 16: "Slow Horses" (Season 6)

"Slow Horses" continues its tradition of releasing a new season every year, and based on reviews, the sixth season appears to be yet another critically acclaimed entry.

This British spy thriller series, adapted from Mick Herron's novels, continues to deliver精彩 stories with its signature dark humor, thrilling plot twists, and the Slough House team led by Gary Oldman's Jackson Lamb.

September 23: "Brothers"

"Brothers" stars real-life longtime friends Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson in a new comedy series with a delightfully playful premise.

Series creator Lee Eisenberg is best known as a writer and producer on some of the most acclaimed seasons of the sitcom "The Office" ("辦公室風雲").

Below is the official series synopsis:

You can add "Brothers" to your Apple TV watchlist here.

October 2: "The Last First: Winter K2"

"The Last First: Winter K2" is a documentary that explores the high-risk world of extreme mountaineering.

The film holds a perfect 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, with multiple reviewers specifically noting that the work offers a fresh perspective that audiences won't see coming. *Variety* wrote: "《The Last First》reveals how they risk their lives for a belief—or perhaps an addiction. The film showcases the dark side of being literally 'high.'"

Below is Apple's official synopsis:

You can add "The Last First: Winter K2" to your Apple TV watchlist here.

October 7 and 9: "Small Prophets" and "Matchbox The Movie"

"Small Prophets" debuts on October 7 and stands out as a unique addition to the Apple TV library. Unlike nearly every other offering on Apple, it is not an Apple Original series, but rather was acquired by Apple for streaming after becoming a hit in the UK earlier this year. Global audiences will soon get the chance to see this multi-award-winning comedy.

"Matchbox The Movie" premieres on October 9 and is a new action-comedy film inspired by Mattel's toys. The film has all the trappings of a blockbuster—big stars, big production—yet will debut exclusively on Apple TV.

Below are the synopses Apple provided for "Small Prophets" and "Matchbox The Movie":

"《Small Prophets》is a comedy about eccentric Michael Sleep (Pearce Quigley), who has been leading a mundane, unfulfilling life ever since his beloved Clea disappeared seven years ago. He works at a DIY store, visits his dad Brian (Sir Michael Palin), and pines for Clea's return. One day, Brian shares with him an ancient recipe consisting of rainwater, horse manure, and a dash of alchemical ingredients. Skeptical but hopeful, Michael sets about brewing 'homunculi'—tiny magical sprites that can predict the future—hoping they can answer his biggest question: 'Will I ever see Clea again?' 《Matchbox The Movie》is a high-octane, globe-trotting adventure about a group of childhood friends who are unexpectedly thrust into an international race to save the world when their long-missing, CIA undercover-agent former leader Sean (John Cena) returns to their small town."

Add to your Apple TV watchlist: "Small Prophets" and "Matchbox The Movie".

Which upcoming Apple TV premiere are you most excited about? Share with us in the comments.

Apple TV is priced at $14.99 per month, and a discount is also available through the Apple One bundle.
